==Biography==
Michael "'''Imaqtpie'''" hails from Margate, Florida in the USA. He was initially a midlane player and played for a minor team called [[Oh God Bears]] in 2011.
===League of Legends Career===
Though he did not want to play competitively at first, when he was asked by [[Scarra]] to join his team, Imaqtpie joined [[Rock Solid]] as their starting AD carry, replacing [[OXICLEAN]]. The team went on to win the [[National_ESL_Premier_League_Season_1|National ESL Premier League]] and were subsequently picked up by [[Team Dignitas]]. Imaqtpie played with Dignitas as their starting AD carry until October 2014, when he stepped down, presumably to pursue streaming full-time.<ref>[http://team-dignitas.net/articles/news/League-of-Legends/6087/Imaqtpie-will-not-re-sign-with-Team-Dignitas Imaqtpie steps down from Team Dignitas]</ref>

Throughout his career on Dignitas, Imaqtpie was known as a competitively strong AD carry, but he was even better known for his streaming personality, from which several community memes originated. On December 15, 2013, he appeared in an episode of [[Reflections]].<ref>[http://www.ongamers.com/articles/reflections-with-imaqtpie/1100-494/ 'Reflections' with Imaqtpie]</ref>

===Stream Presence===
Imaqtpie's stream chat has been the origination point for several community memes, including:
* "ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ Raise Your Dongers ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ"
* Dongsquad and Dongsquad 420
* Book of Dong, a fictional "bible" including teammates and many the phrases he created
* Spamming "BrainSlug," "FrankerZ," and "Kappa" in Twitch.tv channels

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Corki}} play.
* Famous for picking {{ci|Twitch}} and {{ci|Evelynn}} during champion select at tournaments and then switching at the last second.
* Current champion of flippers360 LAN tournament.
* Came up with the username "Imaqtpie" because his mom says he's cute. 
* Uses Garnier Fructis to maintain his luscious locks of hair, citing the pretty scent as the reason that he feels pretty.
* Doesn't like wearing shoes.
* Is known for his {{ci|Heimerdinger}} mechanics.
* Described his play style as "mentally challenged" in an interview with [[SotLTravis]].
* Used to frequently battle [[Chaox]] in "subscriber wars" between their Twitch.tv subscribers.
* His teammates on [[Team Dignitas]] often complained about his long hair, with [[scarra]] commenting that it's "gross" and "self-replicating" within the Dignitas gaming house.
* Originally played mid lane during his time on [[Oh God Bears]] and is known for being good at ranged champions.
* Was asked by scarra to join [[Rock Solid]] as a substitute for starting top laner [[Voyboy]] because Voyboy needed to attend school. 
* Switched to playing AD carry when the current meta of top laner, jungler, mid laner, AD carry and support was first introduced in Season 1.
* Temporarily transferred one of his accounts to the LAN server on December 29, 2014 because of packet loss/high ping on the NA server due to living on the east coast of the US.
* Briefly lived in the [[compLexity]] team house before the start of the LCS in Season 3.
